title: Notifications
emptyBody: You'll hear about tasks assigned to you, and about anything you choose to follow.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.intro: Everything shows up in the bell. Email is optional, and off until you switch it on.
preferences.emailEnabledHint: Send notifications to your account email as well as showing them here.
preferences.onAssign: When something is assigned to me
preferences.onAssignHint: Someone puts a task, deal or account in your name.
preferences.onUpdate: When a task I follow changes
preferences.onUpdateHint: A followed task is edited, completed, or reopened. Batched into one message per burst.
preferences.onDueHint: On the due date of a task, or the next-action date of a deal, that you follow — and once more if it slips.
preferences.onClosedHint: A deal is won or lost, a task is completed, an account is archived.
preferences.ownerDueNote: Due and overdue reminders for work you own are always emailed, whatever is set here — that is how nothing passes its date unnoticed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

watchRecord.ownerNote: You own this — you are always notified.
